title: The LSE Generate Global Innovation Challenge 2026
description: High school students worldwide pitch UN SDG solutions to real problems for cash prizes, internships, and global recognition.
descriptionDetailed: The LSE Generate Global Innovation Challenge is a virtual pitch competition for high school students aged 13-18, run with LSE Generate and Crimson Education. Participants pitch scalable solutions to UN SDG problems, alone or in teams of two to four. Top teams from five regions reach live finals for up to $2,500 in cash, internships, and mentorship.

entry.feeNote: Regular registration costs $20 USD per student; early bird was $15 USD per student and closed on May 31, 2026. Every team member must register and pay individually.

prize.description: 1st place $1,000, 2nd place $750, 3rd place $500. All three winners also receive a virtual internship with LSE Generate founders, a mentorship hour with experts, exclusive access to LSE Generate events, a Certificate of Achievement, and global publication on the website and social media.

audience.eligibilityLabel: For high school students aged 13-18 worldwide
audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to all high school students aged 13-18 from any country, including 9th graders who have yet to turn 13 and gap-year students not enrolled in university credits. Participants may compete individually or in teams of two to four members.
